headline: UP Expressway Projects: ₹24,000 crore mega infrastructure boost in Uttar Pradesh! Two new expressways approved, big bet on industrial projects too
summary: Uttar Pradesh's cabinet, chaired by Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, approved projects worth more than ₹24,000 crore, including two new expressways and industrial projects.
why: Large state infrastructure spending supports construction and industrial activity, and can attract private investment in India's most populous state.
